name: Resend
description: Resend is a developer-first email API designed for modern applications. It provides a clean REST API and React Email integration, making it exceptionally easy to send beautiful transactional emails with minimal setup.

useCases.task: Send transactional emails with dynamic templates
Send password reset and verification emails

setupSteps: Navigate to API Keys in the dashboard
Add your sending domain under Domains

rateLimits.notes: Rate limits apply per API key. Free tier limited to 1 custom domain.
rateLimits.retryStrategy: Exponential backoff starting at 1s, max 3 retries for 429 responses

codeExamples.title: Send a basic email
codeExamples.notes: The 'from' address must use a verified domain. Use onboarding@resend.dev for testing.

codeExamples.title: Send with React Email template
codeExamples.notes: Requires @react-email/components and react as peer dependencies.

gotchas: The 'from' address must use a verified domain — you cannot send from gmail.com or other public domains. Use 'onboarding@resend.dev' only for initial testing.
Free tier limits you to a single domain. If you need multiple domains (e.g., staging + production), upgrade to a paid plan.
Resend does not support bulk/marketing email on the free tier — it is optimized for transactional email. For newsletters, look at Loops or Buttondown instead.

reliability.notes: Resend uses multiple delivery providers as fallback. Delivery typically happens within seconds.

qualityJustification: Resend has the cleanest API of any email provider, with first-class TypeScript support, excellent React Email integration, and a developer experience that's hard to beat. Excellent documentation and fast onboarding. Minor deduction for limited free tier domain count.
bestFor: Developer-first transactional email with the simplest possible API and React Email support
